content.user_title: Process PDFs with Extraction, Forms, and Automation
content.value_statement: PDF work often requires separate tools for extraction, editing, creation, and form completion. This skill provides practical Python, JavaScript, and command-line workflows for those tasks.
actual_capabilities: Extract text, tables, metadata, annotations, and page coordinates from PDF files.
Create, merge, split, rotate, crop, watermark, and encrypt PDF documents.
Inspect fillable fields, validate field identifiers and choices, and populate form values.
Add text annotations to non-fillable forms using validated page bounding boxes.
Render PDF pages as images and create visual overlays for form-placement review.
Guide workflows with pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab, pdf-lib, PDF.js, qpdf, and Poppler tools.
limitations: Required Python packages and command-line utilities must be installed separately.
Scanned documents require OCR, and recognition quality depends on image clarity and language support.
Annotation fonts, sizes, and colors may render differently across PDF viewers.
Complex forms, signatures, permissions, and unusual field structures may require manual review.

use_cases.title: Extract report data
use_cases.description: Convert PDF text and tables into structured content for analysis, review, or spreadsheet workflows.

use_cases.title: Complete document forms
use_cases.description: Inspect fields, validate choices, and produce completed copies of fillable or non-fillable forms.

use_cases.title: Automate PDF pipelines
use_cases.description: Build repeatable workflows for document creation, page manipulation, batch processing, and quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Extract text and tables
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract readable text and tables from [PDF path]. Save tables to [spreadsheet path] and summarize pages that need manual review.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs structured content from a digital PDF.

prompt_templates.title: Combine and organize pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge [PDF paths] in the listed order. Rotate [pages], remove [pages], and save the result to [output path].
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs one organized document from several source files.

prompt_templates.title: Complete a fillable form
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [PDF path] for fillable fields. Map the provided values, validate field choices, create [output path], and report unresolved fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: An operations user must complete a form without changing its field structure.

prompt_templates.title: Annotate a non-fillable form
prompt_templates.prompt: Complete [PDF path] using [data source]. Render pages, validate annotation boxes visually and automatically, then create [output path].
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced workflow must place text accurately on a scanned or flattened form.

output_examples.input: Extract every table from quarterly-report.pdf and save one spreadsheet.
output: Flagged two irregular layouts for manual review.

output_examples.input: Merge three policy PDFs, rotate page four, and create policy-pack.pdf.
output: Merged the three files in the requested order.

output_examples.input: Fill the attached application form with the supplied approved values.
output: Detected 16 fillable fields and validated every field identifier.
Applied 15 values and left the signature field unchanged.

best_practices: Keep source PDFs unchanged and use distinct output paths for generated files.
Validate page counts, field identifiers, and visual placement before distributing results.
Use OCR only for scanned pages, and review uncertain text or table extraction manually.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite source documents unless replacement is explicitly required.
Do not assume annotation placement is correct without inspecting validation images.
Do not remove encryption or fill protected forms without authorization and valid credentials.

faq.question: Can this skill read scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, when OCR dependencies are available. Recognition accuracy depends on scan quality, orientation, language support, and document layout.

faq.question: Does this skill install its dependencies?
faq.answer: No. Python packages and command-line tools such as Poppler, qpdf, or pdftk must be installed separately.

faq.question: Can it fill every PDF form?
faq.answer: It supports standard fillable fields and annotation-based completion. Complex forms, signatures, or unusual permissions may require manual tools.

faq.question: Does it send PDF content over the network?
faq.answer: The included scripts do not send PDF content over the network. Installing dependencies may require separate network access.

faq.question: How should original documents be protected?
faq.answer: Use a distinct output path and retain the source file. Some tools can replace an existing target without confirmation.

faq.question: Can it process password-protected PDFs?
faq.answer: It provides decryption and encryption examples. Processing requires authorization, valid credentials, and support from the selected PDF tool.
